description: Two gates that pass their signal until a set number of clock ticks has gone by, then cut it off

params.text: Opens that row again and sets its count back to zero
Sets how many clock ticks pass before that row cuts off, 1 to 64

inputs.text: The signal that row passes and then cuts off
A trigger here opens that row again and sets its count back to zero

outputs.text: The signal from that row's input until the count is reached, faded out rather than switched

notes: A row starts open and cuts off only once its STP IN jack has counted the number of ticks set, so with nothing patched there the signal keeps passing.

inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
